port_implementation: Bounded Switch behavior port; original source files are not redistributed
changes: PC worldGetAllPeds replaced by target nearby scanner: 32 handles maximum, eight processed per frame
Uses explicit Switch arguments for IS_ENTITY_DEAD and GET_CURRENT_PED_WEAPON_ENTITY_INDEX
Reads damage bone only when its BOOL result is true
Queries and clears damage before weapon drop; one drop for combined hand/weapon hits
Skips invalid, dead, unarmed and player handles; suspends on death/arrest/loss of player control
Refreshes scanner immediately on character change and handles game timer wrap
Namespaced bounded status reports; no per-frame SD writes
